sentences.en: I'm afraid not. I failed to make a single friend.

sentences.en: So you understand what I'm going through.
Oh, I read that book. It's excellent.

sentences.en: I started with water propulsion, worked my way up to solid fuel,

sentences.en: then went back to water after I set our garage on fire.

sentences.en: Well, good luck on your quest to find a friend.
